notes.title: ✨Devlog: Crafting the Islands of Lou’s Lagoon!✨
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=eHegS7wSsrY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone! 

Our latest Lou’s Lagoon devlog is here, and this time, we’re diving deep into how we create the islands you’ll explore in the game.

This devlog focuses on Brian, our art director and level designer, who has been shaping the world of Lou’s Lagoon from the very beginning. If you’re curious about how our archipelago is coming to life, you won’t want to miss this!

Here’s what we’re covering:

[h3]📝 Concepting the Islands[/h3]
 Before an island takes shape in 3D, it all starts with concept art. We’ll be sharing early designs of the islands you’ll see in the game, as well as some ideas that didn’t make the final cut—or might return in the future!

[h3]🩶⏹️ Greyboxing: The Foundation of Level Design ⏹️🩶[/h3]
Islands aren’t just about looking good—they need to be fun to explore. The greyboxing phase ensures that each island has an interesting structure, is readable from a distance, and works well with our mechanics. We’ll show the evolution from raw geometry to fully realized environments.

[h3]🏝️ A Deep Dive into the Islands[/h3]
 Lou’s Lagoon features four major islands, each designed to be visually distinct and offer a unique gameplay experience. In this devlog, we take a closer look at:
Lou’s Island – Your cozy home base.

[list]
[*] Tanglebloom – A jungle-filled mystery.
[*] Gleam Reef – A glowing funky paradise.
[*] Boulderia – A rocky landscape tied to an enormous crab-shaped surprise.
[/list]

Oh, and one more thing… 🛩️

If you missed it, Lou’s Lagoon was featured in a recent Nintendo Direct showcase! [b]That means we’re officially coming to Nintendo Switch alongside our Steam release![/b] We’re beyond excited to bring the game to even more players, and we can’t wait for you all to explore the archipelago.

Check out the new devlog and let us know which island you’re most excited to visit! 🚀

notes.title: ✈️ Out Now! Lou’s Lagoon on Kickstarter! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey Pilots! ✈️


The moment we’ve been super excited for is here: [b]Our Kickstarter campaign for Lou’s Lagoon has officially launched![/b] This is YOUR chance to support the development of Lou’s Lagoon and be part of our cozy island adventure from the start. 
Join us now on Kickstarter and soar right into our vibrant archipelago!



[previewyoutube=vbdIzU8xxaU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Take to the skies and run your own seaplane delivery service
[/h2]

In our vibrant archipelago, adventure is always just a flight away. Take over the seaplane delivery service of your disappeared uncle Lou - after repairing the plane, it’s time to explore the different islands, each with its own flora, fauna, inhabitants and challenges for you to overcome! Help the islanders by delivering goods, harvesting, crafting, fishing, and more. Build and decorate your cozy corner on the islands and discover secrets as you go.

With your support on Kickstarter, we can add even [b]more content, locations, and surprises to the game[/b]—including our first stretch goal: the [b]Island Expansion[/b] featuring a new island in the archipelago! 🏝️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42720288/cfcbee5d4addd170077da72cffc146faf45438ce.png[/img]

[h2]Early Bird Special[/h2]

We have an Early Bird Special available in limited quantities, and some extra special backer rewards for those of you who want to be ✨extra✨ involved and leave their mark on Lou’s Lagoon.

Are you interested? Then [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tinyroar/lous-lagoon]join our Kickstarter now![/url]

Thank you so much for your enthusiasm and support. Together, we’ll make Lou’s Lagoon the best it can be! Let’s take this journey to new heights. ✈️💖

notes.title: Demo Update: Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hi Pilots!

We hope you’re enjoying the demo! We’re excited to share more details about the work that went into it in a Devlog very soon. In the meantime, we’re making the following changes and fixes later today:

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jackie has closed-up shop for the time being to restock.
[*] Made some tweaks to the quest flow
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed main menu UI disappearing when pressing Esc/Select
[*] Fixed duplicate music during demo end trailer
[*] Fixed UI focus being stuck in settings when resuming gameplay
[*] Fixed some placement & wording of button input prompts
[/list]
That’s all for now! If you haven’t already played the demo, we’d love to see you on the island. There’s also time to enter our giveaway to win a copy of the game via [url=https://discord.gg/VfUWkQ8XX6]Discord[/url] or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/tinyroargames.bsky.social/post/3li5ijibpdk2q]Bluesky[/url].

[i]The Lou’s Lagoon Team[/i]

notes.title: Lou's Lagoon Demo FAQs
notes.content:
[h3]WHAT ARE THE SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS?[/h3]
[b]MINIMUM:[/b]
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10 64-bit 
[*] RAM: 4 GB 
[*] GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or similar (4 GB VRAM) 
[*] CPU: Intel Core i3-9100F or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 
[/list]
[b]RECOMMENDED [/b]
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10 64-bit 
[*] RAM: 8 GB 
[*] GPU: GTX 1660 SUPER or similar (6+ GB VRAM) 
[*] CPU: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
[/list]
[h3]WHAT IS LOU’S LAGOON?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lou’s Lagoon is a Seaplane Delivery Service Adventure game
[*] Search for your uncle Lou, who mysteriously vanished and left you his Seaplane, while picking up and expanding his business
[*] Explore the colorful islands of the Limbo archipelago, each one with their own style, inhabitants, and hidden treasures
[/list]
[h3]WHERE CAN I DOWNLOAD THE DEMO?[/h3]
Head to our Steam page to download the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100020/Lous_Lagoon/

[h3]HOW LONG IS THE DEMO?[/h3]
That depends totally on your playstyle and how much time you take to explore the starting island and overworld! If you rush through it, you might finish it in ~15 minutes, if you take your time, it might be ~1 hour or even longer!

[h3]IS THE DEMO AVAILABLE IN MULTIPLE LANGUAGES?[/h3]
The demo is currently available in English and Simplified Chinese. We’re planning to add more languages next time around - thanks for your understanding!

[h3]ON WHICH PLATFORMS IS THE DEMO AVAILABLE?[/h3]
The demo is available through Steam.

[h3]DOES THE DEMO HAVE CONTROLLER SUPPORT?[/h3]
Yes - we even recommend controllers! Note that, depending on the controller you use, some button prompts may not be shown correctly.

[h3]CAN I SHARE SCREENSHOTS OR VIDEOS OF THE DEMO ON SOCIAL MEDIA?[/h3]
Please do! We’d be super happy to see how your adventures in the Limbo archipelago are going and we appreciate any help spreading the word about the game. 

[h3]ARE THERE ANY KNOWN BUGS OR ISSUES IN THE DEMO?[/h3]
[list]
[*] HUD UI elements may not be displayed correctly
[*] Performance may be lower around the tornado
[*] Graphical bugs may occur in the overworld environment
[*] The game cannot be exited during character creation
[*] NPC quest-markers may not appear over characters’ heads when they should
[*] Hefti might turn away when talking to you (he's not trying to be rude, just a little shy!)
[*] Button prompts are only mapped for Xbox Controllers - other controllers still work but the prompts shown may be incorrect
[/list]
[h3]WHERE CAN I REPORT BUGS?[/h3]
To report a bug, you can either press F12 in-game to directly report the issue with a screenshot attached, or[url=https://discord.gg/VfUWkQ8XX6] join our Discord[/url] server and use the dedicated channel to report bugs there. Using Discord is the best way for us to get back to you quickly!

notes.title: How We Fake Clouds In Our Seaplane Delivery Game | Devlog
notes.content:
Hey folks👋!

We're thrilled to share our latest Lou's Lagoon Devlog! 🚀 This time, Ines from Tiny Roar dives deep into some exciting new features, like improved flying mechanics and the new ring challenge—perfect for testing your skills in the skies. You'll also see the introduction of a "Scanner" for uncovering hidden resources, plus a new glider and a first look at our upcoming fishing system.


[h3]We are particularly proud of the “flying through the clouds effect” ... This “trick” or “secret” was created by one of our developers. Have a look at the devlog, then you will understand our “trick” behind it :D..[/h3]

Don't miss the update on our customizable delivery building and fresh city assets for more personalized gameplay. And of course, we're wrapping it all up with some fun behind-the-scenes moments, including our unfortunate office flood! 💦


[h2]Check out all the details in the Devlog video here:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=SAQUdk2US_8;full][/previewyoutube]


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tinyroar/lous-lagoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42720288/e1ce41e3c52c10515bd23d0e5a0049671f463cda.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tinyroar/lous-lagoon/][i]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tinyroar/lous-lagoon/[/i][/url]

We can't wait for you to dive back into the lush and vibrant Limbo Archipelago, search for your Uncle Lou, and take over his seaplane delivery service. Explore the islands, gather resources, and hone your crafting skills to complete jobs and grow your business—all while getting closer to uncovering the mystery of Lou's disappearance.

[b]Let us know what you think about our new Devlog![/b] Your feedback is important to us and we’d love to hear your thoughts! 🗨️💬

Thank you for your support! ❤️
See you in the skies! ✈️☁️

The Lou's Lagoon Team
